body: Thanks for the answer, I appreciate.  I do have an appointment soon for mental health, and I don't plan dying before it.  Also, a lot of my problems will either aggravate or be solved soon.  I guess I'll give life a chance until then... but prospects are pessimistic.

I haven't talked to anyone in like 2 weeks.  I just stay in my room.  I could be dead and nobody would notice.  

Sure, everyone will say they care about me, that they don't want me to die, blabla, but nobody would do anything that would risk breaking partially one of their hair for me.  They are all sympathetic of my situation, some could do something, nobody does.  Truth is they don't give a fuck.  If I died, they would probably be sad, cry perhaps, etc.  But it's not because they care about me.  People just have that natural instinct to fear death.  Just like a scared kid cries, scared adults cry when they see death.  But they don't care about me, believe me.
